purpose: Teach: フォワード/グレート/ケルト/カルマ/ショッキング/悪者/ワニ/ひぐらし

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサッカーのフォワードの動きを教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — your father's going to teach you how a soccer forward moves.
lines.style: Warm, gentle observation. Speaking to Sho but also to herself, noticing something tender happening between father and son. Soft, unhurried pace. Slight uplift at the end, like offering a gift of attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとグレート・ギャツビーの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-san — I looked at a Great Gatsby picture book with Dad!
lines.style: Bright and immediate, barely contained excitement. Quick delivery. Breathless on the run-on thought. Eyes shining with the pride of sharing something he discovered with his dad.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがケルト音楽のCDを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father gave you a Celtic music CD.
lines.style: Tender noticing. Slower, more contemplative than before. There's quiet pleasure in cataloguing these small gifts. Trailing off slightly, like she's watching something unfold.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが仏教のカルマの絵本を読んで下さるよ
lines.en: Mei-san — Dad's going to read me a picture book about Buddhist karma!
lines.style: Earnest excitement, but grounded — not performing. Clear, deliberate pacing. The words matter to him. Small smile in the voice. Almost shy about how much this means.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがショッキングなニュースを優しく説明して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father explained something upsetting to you so gently.
lines.style: Reflective and slightly hushed. Speaking as if naming something important she's witnessing. Measured pace. Soft, almost wondering — this is the kind of parenting she notices.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと悪者退治のごっこ遊びをしたよ
lines.en: Mei-san — I played a good-guys-and-bad-guys game with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious joy. Quick, light delivery. The kind of unbuttoned happiness only a young child can show. Natural, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが動物園のワニ舎の解説を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father read the placard to you at the crocodile house.
lines.style: Reflective and warm. Slower pace, noticing another quiet moment of care. There's something almost poignant in how she catalogs these — father as guide, explainer, the adult who takes time to read the small signs.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがひぐらしの鳴き声を録音されたよ
lines.en: Mei-san — Dad recorded the sound of the evening cicadas!
lines.style: Bright close to the exchange. Immediate delight, quick pace. This detail — the recording — lands with special wonder. Almost breathless, like it's the best discovery yet.
